parameters.content:
## Dailymotion Video Discovery by Topic & Channel

**Actor:** [Dailymotion Video Discovery by Topic & Channel](https://apify.com/dataspryva/dailymotion-video-discovery-by-topic-and-channel)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/dailymotion-video-discovery-by-topic-and-channel.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `topic` (string)
- `videoIds` (array)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `language` (string)
- `country` (string)
- `verifiedOnly` (boolean)
- `liveOnly` (boolean)
- `tag` (string)
- `createdAfter` (string)
- `createdBefore` (string)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `ownerUsername` (Owner Username)
- `views` (Views)
- `likes` (Likes)
- `duration` (Duration)
- `publishedAt` (Published At)
- `videoUrl` (Video Url)

description: Dailymotion video discovery: runs the Dailymotion Video Discovery by Topic & Channel Apify Actor, returns title, ownerUsername, views, likes, duration and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
